class.name: JenovaFrameImporter
class.brief_description: An importer that loads the proprietary Jenova Frame (.jframe) binary format sequence and animates the active scene using its data.
class.description: [JenovaFrameImporter] is an engine singleton that imports a Jenova Frame Sequence into the active scene. Any 3D scene in the engine can be exported using [GameRecorder3D]. Can be accessed from [b]Scene > Import... > Import Jenova Frame Sequence...[/b] [b]Note:[/b] Only available in the editor.

method.name: open_import_dialog
method.description: Opens the importer dialog to import frame sequence data.

method.name: import_animation_sequence
method.description: Directly imports a frame sequence from a file using the specified framerate.
